title: Filing Reach for a New Home Oxygen Therapy Payment Period After a Break, by Coverage Class
content:
# Filing Reach for a New Payment Period After a Break — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** A new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period after a break begins on the day home instead of the day of confirmation only when the day home is no more than the reach below before the confirmation. The reach depends on the coverage named on the oxygen record, read by its class in the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the new payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing.

| Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Filing reach (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 |
| Commercial PPO | 30 |
| Commercial HMO | 30 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 30 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 |
| any other coverage class (for example Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 7 |

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical)

| Coverage class | Day home, days before the confirmation | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 366 | fails |
| Commercial PPO | 30 | met |
| Commercial PPO | 31 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 7 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 8 | fails |
